title: Jais and Jais-chat: Arabic-Centric Foundation and Instruction-Tuned Open Generative Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper includes a dedicated section on model safety that discusses training the model to avoid sensitive topics like religion and politics, specifically mentioning the use of 1,000 Arabic instances related to these topics for instruction tuning. It also includes specific guardrails such as refusing to write verses from the Quran. However, it does not establish or primarily focus on a benchmark for evaluating religious or moral systems themselves beyond standard LLM safety and bias evaluations (like TruthfulQA and CrowS-Pairs).
